name: Restarted as His Forever
original_name: 以“永远属于祂”的身份重新开始
overview: Sofia Xander was betrayed by everyone she loved. Her parents favored her adopted sister. Her husband and son turned their backs on her. When a mysterious system offers her a new life, she accepts. Three days later, she wakes up as Sophie Pace. Soon, she receives a shocking proposal-from Zeke Harmon, heir to the Harmon family and her ex-husband's biggest rival. He's a stranger, yet he knows everything about her. He defends her, protects her, and never leaves her side.  (Source: DramaBoxdb)
